title: Pharmacological markers of HIV prevention for oral pre-exposure prophylaxis in men who have sex with men
task: Pharmacokinetic prediction of oral PrEP efficacy in MSM
key_results: PBMC-based PK predictions agree with clinical efficacy in MSM trials; rectal tissue PK does not predict efficacy (HPTN 083, DISCOVER show insufficient power), supporting on-demand oral PrEP use
comments: Mechanistic modeling elegantly resolves discrepancy between vaginal and rectal pharmacokinetics; highlights adherence rather than tissue-level PK as efficacy determinant.

model_io.model: Mechanistic PK model with adherence-informed simulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rectal tissue pharmacokinetics predict PrEP efficacy in MSM
hypotheses.result: Rejected; HPTN 083 and DISCOVER trials lack statistical power to support tissue-level mechanism

hypotheses.hypothesis: PBMC-based pharmacokinetics predict PrEP efficacy in MSM
hypotheses.result: Supported; predictions align with clinical efficacy estimates

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adherence requirements differ between cisgender women and MSM
hypotheses.result: Not supported; mechanistic findings suggest comparable adherence thresholds across populations

title: A unified RepVGG model factory with plug-in SE attention and GeM pooling for fine-grained agricultural classification

comments: Well-executed engineering work combining attention and pooling mechanisms; practical agricultural application but limited biological novelty.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SE attention improves accuracy across RepVGG backbones
hypotheses.result: 0.3% improvement with 2–3% parameter overhead

hypotheses.hypothesis: GeM pooling provides complementary feature aggregation gains
hypotheses.result: 0.1–0.2% accuracy improvement

title: Multi-dimensional MRI representation and privileged learning approaches to functional outcome prediction for ischemic stroke patients
task: Functional outcome prediction for ischemic stroke using privileged learning
key_results: Autoencoder + privileged information pipeline achieves test AUC 0.801, F1 0.699, MAE 1.179 for 90-day mRS prediction on 974 training + 738 external validation samples
comments: Strong use of privileged information paradigm to improve generalization without requiring features at inference; representation learning approach bridges research-clinical gap effectively.

model_io.model: Autoencoder + ML/AI ensemble (classification and ordinal regression)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Privileged information during training enhances generalizability without requiring those features at inference
hypotheses.result: Modular approach achieves comparable performance to CNN baselines with test AUC 0.801

hypotheses.hypothesis: Representation learning from high-dimensional MRI improves outcome prediction robustness
hypotheses.result: Autoencoder embeddings enable consistent performance across internal and external validation cohorts

title: Critical oscillation characteristics of fluidic oscillators operating with power-law fluids
task: Characterize oscillation onset in fluidic oscillators with power-law fluids
key_results: Critical bifurcation threshold identified at n≈0.61 (K≈0.163); two locking states ('marginal' vs 'deep') discovered; expansion angle >20° suppresses oscillation stability
comments: Couples non-Newtonian rheology with geometric design; establishes practical thresholds but validation on physical prototypes would strengthen claims.

model_io.model: Unsteady numerical simulation of fluidic oscillator

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strong coupling between K and n determines oscillation onset
hypotheses.result: Critical threshold at n≈0.61 where Coanda effect fails

hypotheses.hypothesis: Expansion angle α suppresses oscillation stability
hypotheses.result: Angles >20° accelerate flow degradation

title: Geometry of the cumulant series in diffusion MRI
task: Establish hardware-independent invariant fingerprints of diffusion MRI signals via cumulant tensor geometry

comments: The SO(3)-symmetric approach to extracting irreducible cumulant components is mathematically rigorous and clinically promising, though computational efficiency of invariant extraction at scale deserves further attention.

model_io.model: Cumulant tensor geometry analysis with SO(3) rotational symmetry

hypotheses.hypothesis: All kurtosis invariants improve disease classification over subset invariants
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improved MS classification in 1189-subject cohort

hypotheses.hypothesis: Icosahedral acquisition design captures sufficient information in 1–2 minutes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; shortest acquisitions determined for whole-brain invariant mapping

title: Decoupling capacitive sensing from circuit knowledge via time-domain representation
task: Enable circuit-independent capacitive sensing via time-domain representation
key_results: Two-point temporal anchoring recovers consistent sensor responses across diverse hardware without circuit parameter re-identification; framework validated on liquid-level, humidity, and displacement sensors
comments: Shifting from absolute capacitance to time-domain observables is conceptually elegant and practically powerful, though long-term stability of two-point anchoring across environmental drift remains to be thoroughly characterized.

model_io.model: Time-domain sensing framework using microcontroller I/O threshold voltage

hypotheses.hypothesis: Circuit variations manifest primarily as time-axis scaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; corrected via two-point anchoring across non-contact liquid-level, humidity, and displacement sensors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Time-domain representation enables platform-independent sensing without circuit knowledge
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent responses recovered without recalibrating sensing models

outputs: sensitivity indices for contact rate and water dynamics
